issue.title: Collect gate inputs in a dedicated panel instead of the gate modal's left pane
issue.description: Selecting a gate option opens a wide, dedicated input panel that shows exactly that selection's input components under their owning option, navigable with <tab> and <shift+tab>, with full vim insert/normal editing in every freeform box; the gate modal's left pane shows only decisions.

issue.title: Vim editing for every typed freeform field
issue.description: editors: give the shared TypedInputForm a masked single-line vim editor for secret fields and a multi-line vim editor for text-typed and repeatable fields, and route each editor's vim mode display to a host screen hook.

issue.title: The GateInputPanel modal and its pure request model
issue.description: panel: add the pure per-option input request/collection model and the GateInputPanel modal screen that renders it, with a tab/shift+tab focus ring, live validity, drafts, and a submit that returns per-option values.

issue.title: Route every gate submission through the panel
issue.description: wire: make GateBranchControls open the panel when a selection needs typed input, delete the inline Inputs section and the inline feedback box, and simplify the focus ring and submit-state bookkeeping in both gate modals.

issue.title: Configurable panel keymaps and modal footers
issue.description: keys: add open_inputs, next_input, and previous_input to the gate keymap scope, thread the effective keys into the panel and both gate-modal footers, and keep declared gate-action keys from stealing them.

issue.title: Panel styling, option input badges, and visual snapshots
issue.description: chrome: style the panel so field text does not wrap, badge every option that declares inputs, drop the dead inline-input styles, and rebaseline plus extend the gate PNG goldens.

issue.title: Document the panel and its keys
issue.description: docs: update the notifications gate-review and gate-inputs prose, the gate keymap tables, and the gate remapping example to describe panel-based collection.
